recipe.visualDefinition: A performer, seen from behind, stands center-left, holding a microphone stand. He wears a light-colored shirt with a large, detailed illustration of two figures on the back. The background is a dark, desaturated collage of numerous small, indistinct crowd photos, creating a sense of a large audience or past events. The overall mood is somber and reflective.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's back faces the viewer, creating a sense of introspection or performance.
The illustrated figures on the jacket are prominent and detailed, drawing immediate attention.
The dark, desaturated crowd in the background contrasts with the central figure, emphasizing his presence.
The microphone stand acts as a vertical anchor, connecting the performer to the ground.
coreInvariants: Central figure seen from behind, holding a microphone stand.
Detailed illustration of two figures on the back of the central figure's shirt.
Dark, desaturated, collaged crowd images in the background.
Overall dark and muted color palette with warm tones on the jacket illustration.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject (performer) occupies the left half of the frame, from mid-thigh to just above the head, appearing large and dominant. His back is towards the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The performer's body and the microphone stand serve as the primary visual anchors, grounding the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the performer's back and the detailed illustration on his shirt, then scans the dark, collaged background. The text in the upper right provides a secondary point of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, desaturated crowd images in the background function as negative space, framing the central figure and emphasizing his isolation or prominence.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark grays and blacks dominate the background, creating a somber and expansive atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The warm browns, oranges, and skin tones of the illustrated figures on the jacket provide a strong contrast against the dark background and the performer's lighter shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle highlights on the microphone stand and the performer's watch provide minor metallic accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is low saturation and low value, while the central figure's shirt and the jacket illustration have higher saturation and value, making them stand out.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a predominantly dark and desaturated background.
Ensure the jacket illustration uses warm, earthy tones.
Limit bright, highly saturated colors to small accents if any.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The 'Last Lap' title uses a flowing, script-like skeleton with connected strokes. 'ROD WAVE' uses a sans-serif skeleton with consistent stroke width.
letterConstructionRules: For 'Last Lap', letters are fluid and connected, mimicking handwriting with varying stroke thickness.
Ascenders and descenders are moderate, maintaining legibility.
For 'ROD WAVE', letters are uppercase, monoline, and evenly spaced.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark background, not interfering with the main subject
placed over the dark background, below the main title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A flowing script for the title paired with a clean, simple sans-serif for the artist name, creating a contrast between expressive and functional typography. A distinct warning label for legal information.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory Explicit Content label in a black box with white text.

preserve: The handwritten, flowing quality of 'Last Lap'.
The clean, all-caps sans-serif style of 'ROD WAVE'.
The distinct black box and white text of the Parental Advisory label.
avoid: Serif fonts for the artist name.
Overly decorative or complex scripts for 'Last Lap' that compromise legibility.
Changing the standard Parental Advisory graphic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten feel of 'Last Lap'.
Offers a similar flowing aesthetic for 'Last Lap' but with more consistent stroke width.
Matches the clean, modern, all-caps style of 'ROD WAVE'.
For the Parental Advisory label, to maintain its blocky, authoritative look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an image of a performer seen from behind, holding a microphone stand. He wears a light-colored shirt with a large, detailed illustration of two figures on the back, rendered in warm, earthy tones. The background should be a dark, desaturated collage of numerous small, indistinct crowd photos, creating a sense of a large audience or past events. Ensure the overall mood is somber and reflective, with the central figure prominent against the muted background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the text 'Last Lap' in a flowing, white script in the upper right quadrant, slightly angled. Below it, add 'ROD WAVE' in a smaller, clean, all-caps white sans-serif. In the bottom left corner, place the 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' label in its standard black box with white text.

verificationChecks: Is the 'Last Lap' text clearly a flowing script?
Is 'ROD WAVE' a simple, all-caps sans-serif?
Is the Parental Advisory label correctly positioned and styled?
Are all text elements white and legible against the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Exact angle and position of the 'Last Lap' title.
Specific typeface for 'ROD WAVE' (within sans-serif category).
Subtle variations in the handwritten style of 'Last Lap' (e.g., stroke thickness, connection points).
Scale of the Parental Advisory label.

mustAchieve: The central figure must be clearly visible from behind, holding a microphone.
The jacket illustration must be detailed and visually distinct.
The background must convey a sense of a large, indistinct crowd in dark tones.
The typography must be legible and maintain the specified stylistic contrast.
avoid: Bright, distracting colors in the background.
Overly complex or illegible fonts for the artist name.
Any text overlapping or obscuring the main subject's face or the jacket illustration.

postGenerationChecks: Verify the performer's back is facing the viewer.
Confirm the jacket illustration is prominent and detailed.
Check that the background is a dark, desaturated crowd collage.
Ensure 'Last Lap' is a flowing script and 'ROD WAVE' is a clean sans-serif.
Confirm the Parental Advisory label is present and correctly styled.
Assess overall legibility and mood consistency.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate the composition with a central figure seen from behind, wearing a custom-illustrated jacket against a dark, collaged crowd background. Apply a flowing script for the main title and a clean sans-serif for the artist name, both in white, positioned in the upper right. Include the standard Parental Advisory label in the bottom left.
